## OpusGraph

URL: https://elarenstudio.com/opusgraph/

An Elaren Studio product

Music library management for orchestras, choirs, bands, and other performing ensembles—replacing the spreadsheets most organizations rely on today.

Catalog your sheet music, track parts and copies, log performance history, and plan seasons—powered by a curated classical music reference database that fills in the details for you.

### Your music library, finally in order

Everything an ensemble librarian tracks—works, parts, copies, conditions, locations, and programs—in one place instead of seventeen tabs.

### Catalog your whole library

Title, composer, arranger, publisher, instrumentation, copies owned, physical location, and condition—searchable and filterable by any combination.

### Track parts, not just pieces

Structured part-by-part tracking with quantity and condition per part, so you know exactly what is on the shelf before you program it.

### Performance history that sticks

Log concerts and services with full programs, and see at a glance when each piece was last performed as you plan the next season.

### A reference database that fills in the blanks

Type a work title and OpusGraph suggests matches from its curated classical music database—auto-filling instrumentation, duration, and publisher.

### Escape the spreadsheet

CSV import migrates your existing Google Sheets or Excel library with column mapping and duplicate detection.

### Built for organizations

Each ensemble gets its own isolated library with owner, manager, and member roles—and individuals get the same features in a personal library.

### Any ensemble with a library to keep

OpusGraph is multi-tenant: organizations get isolated libraries with roles, and individual musicians get a personal library with the same features.

### Orchestras

Season planning, part tracking, and performance history for professional and community orchestras.

### Choirs and church music

Catalog octavos and service music, log services, and know your copy counts before rehearsal.

### Bands and ensembles

From wind bands to chamber groups—any ensemble that owns sheet music and programs concerts.

### Status

**Live**

OpusGraph is live and in active development, with its reference database and library tools growing steadily. The studio maintains OpusGraph as one of its flagship products.

OpusGraph is built by Elaren Studio, a product studio operated by Wright Torres Group, LLC, which owns and operates OpusGraph.

## AgentMeter

URL: https://elarenstudio.com/agentmeter/

An Elaren Studio product

A tiny macOS menu bar app that keeps your AI coding usage limits visible at a glance—so you find out you're near a limit before your tools do.

Free and open source. No Dock icon, no accounts, no telemetry—just meters and reset countdowns for the providers you actually use.

### Usage meters that respect your attention

One quiet menu bar item covering subscription limits and pay-as-you-go balances across the AI coding tools you rely on.

### Every provider, one glance

Codex, Cursor, Claude Code, and Gemini limits read automatically from the tools you already use—plus balance meters for OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Kimi, Z.ai, and Venice API keys.

### Reads well before it runs out

Count usage up or down, see relative or exact reset times, and get optional notifications when a limit window or balance crosses your threshold.

### Never cries wolf

If a provider briefly fails to respond, the last known numbers stay visible—dimmed, with a "stale since" note—instead of an alarming error in your menu bar.

### Fits your menu bar

Full, compact, or icon-only styles, with color states at the same thresholds as the meters. Show every provider or just the most constrained one.

### Accessible by design

Full VoiceOver support: the menu bar item speaks a per-provider summary, meters announce values and severity, and warning states use symbols, not just color.

### Your agents can read it too

An opt-in, read-only JSON snapshot and an agentmeter CLI let scripts and coding agents check remaining quota before starting a big task.

### Built to be verified, not trusted

AgentMeter reads sensitive credentials, so it is engineered—and open-sourced—to prove it handles them correctly.

### Credentials stay yours

For Codex, Cursor, Claude, and Gemini, credentials are read fresh on each refresh from the locations the official tools already use. AgentMeter never writes them anywhere, and they never leave your machine except on the request to that provider's own API.

### Keys live in your Keychain

API keys you provide are stored only in your macOS Keychain, shown masked in Settings, removable with one click, and sent only to that provider's own API. AgentMeter detects key types and always recommends the least-privileged key that works.

### No telemetry, ever

No analytics, no accounts, no tracking. AgentMeter is open source under the MIT license, so you can verify exactly what it does—and updates ship through signed, notarized releases.

### Status

**Shipped and open source**

AgentMeter is released under the MIT license with signed, notarized builds and automatic updates. Source code, releases, and the agent interface documentation live on GitHub.

AgentMeter is free, open-source software built by Elaren Studio, a product studio operated by Wright Torres Group, LLC.

## Studio Register

URL: https://elarenstudio.com/studioregister/

An Elaren Studio product

Booking, deposits, agreements, and studio operations for independent photographers. One place to run the business side of a creative practice—without a photography-platform subscription.

Clients see real availability, reserve an actual time, accept the session agreement, and pay a secure deposit. The photographer gets a private workspace that keeps bookings, balances, and requests in order.

### A complete booking flow, built carefully

From published availability to a confirmed session, every step is designed to be unambiguous for the client and reliable for the studio.

### Real availability, no double-booking

The studio owner publishes exact session slots. Clients pick a real date and time, and an expiring hold protects it while they finish checkout—so two people can never book the same slot.

### Secure deposits through Stripe

Clients pay a session deposit through Stripe-hosted Checkout. Card details go directly to Stripe and are never seen or stored by Studio Register. The remaining balance is settled with the studio.

### Clear pricing before payment

Every booking shows the package, session price, deposit amount, and remaining balance before any payment step. What the client reviews is exactly what is charged.

### Versioned session agreements

Clients review and accept the exact agreement version in effect at booking time. The accepted text is kept immutably with the booking record.

### Request-first event coverage

Venue-dependent sessions like birthday and quinceañera coverage start as a request—no payment taken and no date reserved until the studio confirms the details.

### A calm owner workspace

A private workspace for the booking queue, availability changes, package catalog, agreement history, and payment-provider status—focused on upcoming work, not vanity metrics.

### How money moves through Studio Register

Payments are simple by design: one deposit per booking, processed by Stripe, with nothing charged until the client completes checkout.

### What clients pay for

Photography session bookings: portrait, headshot, senior, quinceañera, and event sessions offered by the studio using Studio Register. Clients pay a deposit at booking; the balance is due to the studio around the session.

### How payment works

Payments are processed by Stripe through a secure, Stripe-hosted checkout page created for each individual booking. Studio Register verifies payment through Stripe before confirming a reservation, and Stripe issues the payment receipt.

### Cancellations and refunds

Each booking is governed by the session agreement the client reviews and accepts before paying, including its cancellation and refund terms. If a checkout is abandoned or a hold expires, no charge is made.

### Status

**In development, first studio onboarding**

Studio Register is in active development, with its first deployment being configured for an independent Dallas–Fort Worth photography studio. Each deployment serves a single studio, with the booking experience carrying that studio's own brand.

Studio Register is built by Elaren Studio, a product studio operated by Wright Torres Group, LLC, which owns and operates Studio Register.

### Pricing FAQ

**Do you guarantee rankings, leads, or revenue?**
No. SEO and conversion work is measurable, but nobody can honestly promise specific outcomes. What we guarantee is clear scope, consistent execution, and transparent reporting.

**Do I pay for Care on top of a Growth retainer?**
No. All Growth retainers include Standard Care (hosting, security, backups, monitoring, technical repair).

**What's included in "unlimited text & image updates" (Care+)?**
Text and image swaps on existing pages. Queue-based (one active request at a time), 48 business-hour turnaround. Each request should take under 30 minutes. Excludes layout changes, new sections, new pages, or redesign work.

**What counts as "technical breakage repair"?**
Things that aren't working correctly: form failures, errors, plugin conflicts, platform issues. Different from content edits.

**What are the payment terms for builds?**
50% to start, 25% at design approval, 25% pre-launch.

**What's the minimum commitment for Growth retainers?**
6 months. SEO needs time to compound. Third-party tools and ad spend billed at cost.

**Can I add a location to an existing site?**
Yes. Additional locations using the same design system are $3,500 each.

## Therapist Websites

URL: https://elarenstudio.com/therapist-websites/

Websites for Therapy Practices That Build Trust and Book More Consults.

We design and build bright, enduring websites for therapists and group practices—fast, clean, and conversion-focused.

### Why It Matters

Your website is often the first impression a potential client has of your practice.

- **Build trust in 5 seconds**: A clean, professional site tells visitors they're in the right place before they read a single word.
- **Make your services clear**: Help visitors understand what you offer and whether you're the right fit—without confusion.
- **Increase consult inquiries**: Better conversion flow means more of the right people actually reach out to schedule.

### What's Included

- Custom design + setup — Tailored to your practice, not a generic template.
- Mobile optimization — Looks and works beautifully on every device.
- Up to 5 core pages — Home, About, Services, Contact, and one more of your choice.
- Basic SEO setup — Title tags, meta descriptions, and local search basics.
- Analytics setup — Know where your visitors come from and what they do.
- Hosting, security & backups — SSL, uptime monitoring, and weekly backups included.

### Pricing

**Step 1: Get your site built**

Website Launch — $500 one-time (founding client rate; standard rate $1,200)
- Custom design + build
- Up to 5 pages
- Mobile-optimized
- SEO + analytics setup
- 2 rounds of revisions
- Optional add-on: We write your pages (professional copywriting) — +$750

**Step 2: Choose your monthly plan**

Essentials — $49/month
- Premium hosting + SSL
- Weekly backups
- Uptime monitoring
- Security updates
- 1 small edit request/month

Care+ (Most Popular) — $129/month
- Everything in Essentials
- Unlimited small edits (48-hr turnaround)
- Monthly conversion tune-up
- Monthly local SEO maintenance
- Google Business Profile update support
- Priority support
- Quarterly strategy check-in

Care+ is +$80/mo from Essentials. Upgrade or downgrade anytime—no contracts on monthly plans.

### Process

1. **Discover** — We learn about your practice, your clients, and what makes your approach unique.
2. **Structure** — We map out the pages, content flow, and calls to action that make sense for your practice.
3. **Build** — We design and develop your site—mobile-first, fast, and conversion-focused.
4. **Launch** — Final review, your tweaks, domain connected, live to the world.

Realistic timeline: ~10-day launch target once copy, assets, and access are provided.

### FAQ

**How fast can we launch?**
Our target is ~10 days from the time we have your copy, assets, and access. Most delays come from content gathering, not our build process.

**Do you work with solo and group practices?**
Yes. We work with solo therapists, group practices, and multi-location clinics. The core build scales to fit your team size.

**Can I upgrade from Essentials to Care+ later?**
Absolutely. You can upgrade anytime. It's a simple plan change—no rebuild required.

**Who writes the copy for my website?**
We prefer client-provided copy since you know your practice best. We can help refine and structure what you provide, and copywriting support is available as an add-on (+$750 for all your pages).

**Do you provide HIPAA compliance?**
We build websites, not medical software. We can guide you toward HIPAA-aware hosting and form handling best practices, but we do not provide legal compliance guarantees. For regulated workflows like patient intake or telehealth, we recommend working with a compliance specialist alongside our web build.

**What happens if I need changes after launch?**
On Essentials, you get 1 small edit per month. On Care+, unlimited small edits with 48-hour turnaround. Larger changes are scoped separately.

**Do I own my website?**
Yes. You own the design and content. Hosting and maintenance are part of the monthly plan, but the site itself is yours.

## Therapist Website Design in Houston, TX

URL: https://elarenstudio.com/therapist-website-design-houston-tx/

Therapist Website Design for Houston Practices.

When someone in Houston searches for a therapist, they're usually already stressed. Your website is the first step they take—and it should make that step feel safe and simple. We build bright, enduring websites for therapy practices: calm design, clear navigation, and a straightforward path from visitor to consult request.

### Who This Is For in Houston

- **Solo therapists**: Launching or refreshing a private practice and need a professional site without a $5,000 agency bill.
- **Group practices**: Multiple clinicians, specialties, and locations need structure that scales—not another template.
- **Hybrid practices**: Balancing telehealth and in-person across the Houston metro with clear scheduling paths for both.
- **Teams that want easy updates**: A site you can keep current without learning code or waiting on a developer.

### Common Website Friction Points

- Unclear next step (call vs form vs consult request)
- Buried specialties (modalities and populations hidden in subpages)
- Location confusion (multiple offices, telehealth availability jumbled or missing)
- Privacy discomfort (forms feel intrusive with no expectation-setting)
- Mobile usability (tiny type, hard-to-tap buttons, slow loading)

### Houston-Specific Guidance

Houston clients search by area—The Heights, Montrose, Midtown, Memorial—and by nearby suburbs like Katy, Sugar Land, The Woodlands, and Pearland. We structure sites with one strong Houston hub page, a short "areas we serve" section, and specialty pages that work city-wide. We avoid building dozens of thin neighborhood pages.

Practical detail: include parking and arrival notes for in-person visits. For telehealth, clarify that option near every CTA. For bilingual practices, even a dedicated "Terapia en Español" section captures searches most Houston therapist sites miss.

### Houston FAQ

**Can my site rank for "therapist in The Heights" without doorway pages?**
Yes. One well-structured Houston page with clear specialty and location signals outperforms a stack of thin neighborhood pages. We use proper schema markup and content structure so search engines connect your practice with the areas you actually serve.

**How should I present multiple locations or hybrid telehealth + in-person?**
Each location gets a clear section with address, hours, and parking notes. Telehealth availability should be stated plainly near every contact option—not buried in a FAQ or footer.

**What should a contact form ask to feel safe and not invasive?**
Name, preferred contact method, and a brief note about what they're looking for. Add a short line explaining what happens next. Skip intake-level questions on the website—those come later, through your secure EHR.

**What's the difference between Essentials and Care+ month to month?**
Essentials ($49/mo) covers hosting, security, backups, and 1 small edit per month. Care+ ($129/mo) adds unlimited small edits with 48-hour turnaround, monthly conversion tune-ups, local SEO maintenance, and priority support. Switch anytime.

We also serve practices in Dallas, Fort Worth, and across Texas.

## Group Practice Website Design

URL: https://elarenstudio.com/group-practice-website-design/

Group Practice Website Design That Scales as Your Team Grows.

Group practices have different website needs than solo providers. You need structure that supports multiple clinicians, specialties, and inquiry paths—without overwhelming visitors.

### Built for Multi-Provider Practices

- **Provider directory structure**: Bio pages that are easy to maintain and update as clinicians join or leave the practice.
- **Clear service taxonomy**: Individual, couples, family, child/adolescent—organized so visitors find what they need fast.
- **Inquiry routing**: Clear paths so prospective clients know who to contact and how—reducing confusion and admin overhead.
- **Scalable architecture**: Page structure that grows with your team. Add clinicians and services without a redesign.

### Conversion Priorities for Group Practices

The biggest conversion challenge for groups isn't aesthetics—it's decision complexity. More providers, more services, more ways a visitor can get confused and leave.

- **Help visitors self-select quickly**: Clear navigation and positioning so people find the right provider or service without guessing.
- **Reduce drop-off with simpler decision paths**: Fewer clicks to get from "I might need help" to "here's how to reach out."
- **Make scheduling/contact options explicit**: Whether it's a form, phone number, or intake link—make it obvious and accessible from every page.
- **Keep messaging consistent across providers**: Each clinician page should feel like part of the same practice, not a disconnected profile.

### What We Deliver

- Custom design + setup
- Up to 5 core pages at launch (expandable)
- Mobile-first UX
- SEO/analytics baseline
- Provider directory structure
- Optional ongoing care plans

### Best Fit

This page is for group practices that want a clear, durable website foundation now and incremental optimization over time. Solo therapists may prefer the main therapist website page. Either way, the build process and pricing are the same—the difference is in how we structure the site architecture.

## Local SEO Care

URL: https://elarenstudio.com/local-seo/

Local SEO Care That Turns Search Into Calls. We help home service businesses show up locally and convert that visibility into qualified calls and form submissions — not vanity traffic.

### Who This Is For

Best fit: Home service businesses (cleaning, landscaping, painting, handyman, etc.), 1–3 locations, existing website + Google Business Profile, owners who want structured ongoing execution.

Not a fit: "Rank me by next week" expectations, national SEO campaigns, teams unwilling to provide required access/assets.

### How Engagement Works

**Step 1: Setup Sprint** — $1,800–$3,000 one-time (2–6 weeks)
- Google Business Profile audit + optimization
- Local keyword map
- Tracking baseline (calls, forms, key events)
- On-site implementation (1 page refresh included)
- Citation cleanup (up to 25 updates)

**Step 2: Monthly Local SEO Care**

- Tier A — Maintenance ($850–$1,000/mo): GBP updates + hygiene, citation monitoring, 1 minor on-page refresh/mo, monthly async report + next actions.
- Tier B — Growth ($1,200–$1,500/mo): Everything in Tier A + 1 new local page + 1 refresh/mo, review/reputation workflow, CTA/form conversion tune-ups, quarterly competitor snapshot.
- Tier C — Authority ($1,800–$2,200/mo): Everything in Tier B + 2 new local pages + 2 refreshes/mo, higher-frequency GBP optimization, monthly call/script conversion tuning session.

### What We Measure

Primary KPIs: Qualified calls, qualified form leads, conversion rate on key pages, GBP actions (calls, website clicks, directions). Supporting indicators: Local keyword movement, review velocity and average rating.
